# Scale AI

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 14 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public AI-lab marketing: fixed white nav, black primary and outline login, tight Aeonik display, sales form, separate Inter login.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public marketing and the signed-out dashboard login; no account created). Themes: light.

Public marketing site at [scale.com](https://scale.com/) and the signed-out
login at [dashboard.scale.com/login](https://dashboard.scale.com/login),
read on 2026-11-19. Signed out. Light only. Viewport 1169 by 731 at
devicePixelRatio 2. No account was created.

## Typography

10 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Inter, aeonik, mono.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Aeonik is the marketing face, loaded at weight 400. The page also names
`aeonik Fallback`. Mono is the eyebrow face, loaded. Inter is the login
face, with `-apple-system` and Arial behind it. Aeonik and the mono face
are commercial. The tokens name them and fall back to system stacks. The
font files are not in this package.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The viewport is the pane's fill size, 1169px, not a requested 1440. Phone
width was not set. Social-login pills report a transparent anchor
background. Their face colour is a gap. Spacing steps 2 and 5 are multiples
of the measured `--spacing` and are marked derived. The mono stack's generic
tail is derived. The chart green is the most common non-transparent fill in
the home DOM. It is decorative, not a button colour. Login and marketing
are different products: Inter on the dashboard, Aeonik on the marketing site.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use black for the primary action.** Get Started, Submit, and the login
  button are `#000000` with white type. The outline Log In stays grey on a
  hairline.
- **Keep the two products apart.** Marketing type is Aeonik at a tight
  negative tracking. The login page is Inter, with 24px pills and a grey
  field fill.
- **Leave the rotating word colours on display type only.** Sand and pine
  appear on the home headlines, not on buttons.
- **Do not invent a dark theme.** The page set `data-theme` to light and
  did not offer a switch on these surfaces.
- **Do not submit the demo form as if it were signup.** It asks for a name,
  a company, and a job title.
